risk_if_not_implemented: Without Hardware Token-Based Authentication, credentials may be phished, replayed, guessed or stolen, allowing unauthorized actors to authenticate as trusted identities. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Identity Compromise / Impersonation (R-AC-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2).

compensating_control_1.name: Authenticator Management
compensating_control_1.description:
Mechanisms exist to:
(1) Securely manage authenticators for users and devices; and
(2) Ensure the strength of authentication is appropriate to the classification of the data being accessed.
compensating_control_1.justification: Authenticator Management (IAC-14) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Hardware Token-Based Authentication (IAC-19) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Cryptographic Key Management
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate cryptographic key management controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of keys.
compensating_control_2.justification: Cryptographic Key Management (CRY-10) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of Hardware Token-Based Authentication (IAC-19) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
